title: Santa Ana maximum allowable rent increase
requirement: A landlord may raise rent each year by no more than 3% of the current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index change, whichever is less; the maximum allowable increase is 2.87% for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
key_value: lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI; 2.87% for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027
citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement
requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict, such as nonpayment of rent, breaking the lease, or the owner moving into the property; for certain eviction reasons the landlord may owe relocation assistance.
citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
